description: Scores one entity (or one dimension of one entity -- quality, reliability, communication, ...) from signals contributed by KNOWN, identified sources: reviewer accounts, raters, inspectors, verified buyers. Weighs each signal by tier x source x proof-strength x reputation x recency decay, sums to an effective (credibility-weighted) sample size, and shrinks the result toward a domain baseline ('prior') by a configurable dial -- thin evidence stays close to the prior, deep evidence overrides it. Signals whose combined weight is 0 contribute nothing; when no signal carries weight, confidence is 'insufficient' and the score equals the prior. Evidence dated more than one day after `now` is scored as undated (its recency uses `missingDateAgeDays`). Every signal's `tier`, `source` and `proof` must be a key of the matching weight table, or the call is an error that names the missing key. The built-in example configuration accepts tier new | standard | verified | expert, source imported | referred | direct, and proof none | self_attested | verified | documented; override them with `config.tierWeights`, `config.sourceWeights` and `config.proofWeights`. Inputs that push a derived value past a finite number (for example an enormous dial or weight) are a tool error. Use this for trust/reputation scores backed by attributable evidence. For unattributed/scraped signals with no identity behind them, use assess_anonymous_authenticity instead.

config.description: Partial override merged over the library's illustrative EXAMPLE_IDENTIFIED_CONFIG (tiers new/standard/verified/expert). Real callers should supply their own tier/source/proof vocabulary for their domain -- omit to use the example config as-is.

high.description: Effective sample size at/above which confidence is 'high'.

moderate.description: Effective sample size at/above which confidence is 'moderate'.

halfLifeDays.description: Days for the recency multiplier to halve.

missingDateAgeDays.description: Assumed age (days) for signals with no occurredAt.

neutral.description: Multiplier applied when reputation is unknown.

dial.description: Shrinkage strength: a named preset, or a raw phantom-prior-signal count. Defaults to 'balanced'.

now.description: ISO 'now' timestamp recency decay is computed against. Pass a fixed value for determinism.

prior.description: The domain/category baseline the score shrinks toward when evidence is thin.

signals.description: The identified signals to score from. May be empty (yields the prior, with insufficient confidence).

id.description: Identifier for this signal, for reference in the output.

occurredAt.description: ISO date the underlying event happened, or null if unknown.

proof.description: Key into config.proofWeights -- strength of evidence the event happened.

reputation.description: Contributor reputation 0-100, or null if unknown (treated as neutral).

source.description: Key into config.sourceWeights -- how the signal reached the system.

tier.description: Key into config.tierWeights -- the contributor's standing/tier. The library's illustrative example uses 'new'|'standard'|'verified'|'expert'; supply your own vocabulary via `config.tierWeights`.

name: score_trust_identified
title: Score an entity from known contributors
